dct_description_sm: Published under the Creatives Common License CC BY-NC 4.0. This dataset is a spatially subsampled point cloud, with 0.05 m spacing between points.

This Okotoks Erratic data set is a registered point cloud comprised of twenty-three (23) 3D scans collected on the 15th-16th of November 2016. This data set was collected to provide a comparison data set to data that was collected in 2013 for change detection purposes. The data was collected by Geomatics Engineering students at the University of Calgary with a Leica HDS6100 laser scanner and the data processed with Leica Cyclone REGISTER v9.1 and CloudCompare v2.9.1.
